## What should we build?

A short description of the technology and why rebuilding it from scratch teaches something fundamental.

## Why is it a good fit?

- [ ] It's a real, widely-used technology (not a toy concept)
- [ ] It can be implemented with the standard library (Python preferred)
- [ ] It's scoped to something achievable in one guide
